body:
Maia: Quick kickoff for a short customer spotlight (200-300 words + 30s social). Need recording window and legal release.
Josh: I can record Thu 10-10:30am PT or Fri 2-2:30pm PT. Plan: 3 questions (problem, measurable outcome, one tweetable quote).
Eva: Thu 10 is good for the customer. They want the questions in advance.
Josh: Draft Qs below, please redline: 1) What problem were you solving? 2) What changed after Redwood Inference (metrics if possible)? 3) One short quote we can use publicly?
Sudha: Legal note: we need explicit permission for quote + logo usage. Add a one-line release to the prep doc and collect a signed reply. If numbers are included, customer must sign off.
Maia: I'll add a checkbox release to the prep doc and export PDF after recording. Action: Maia to send for approval.
Daniel: Routing ask: tag leads in SFDC as Case: UX-SPOT-2026 and add a 15-min demo CTA in the publish flow. Also if clicks originate from EU, route to EU SDRs.
Josh: Uploaded draft transcript to Drive: https://drive.redwood/ux-spot/draft.txt. Current quote: "Redwood cut inference latency by 3x and reduced token costs ~40%, which made our feature viable."
Eva: Customer prefers: "reduced per-token costs by ~40% on our production workload."
Sudha: Legal prefers removing exact percentages unless approved. If we don't get explicit approval, change to "significantly reduced per-token cost."
Josh: Noted. I'll include both variants in the doc and flag for one-line email approval.
Maia: Timeline: record Thu, edit + transcript Thu afternoon, legal signoff Fri morning, publish Tue. Is that feasible?
Josh: Yes. I'll deliver the 30s clip Fri AM and drop assets in the release folder.
Sudha: Please cc me on the approval email so I can archive the signed reply in /marketing/legal/releases/UX-spotlight.pdf.
Lexi-bot: Calendar event created: UX Spotlight recording Thu 10:00-10:30 PT (Maia, Josh, Eva, Customer Rep).
Josh: Do we want a micro landing page + blog or just a blog + tweet?
Maia: Micro landing page simple template + blog. One paragraph, quote, screenshot. No long form.
Eva: I'll add screenshot and metrics snippet after recording.
Maia: Recap actions: Josh record Thu; Maia add release text & send approval; customer reply approves numbers or requests redaction; Sudha stores approval; Josh produces 30s clip; Daniel wires SFDC routing + demo CTA; publish Tue.
Josh: Will post final asset links here when ready.
Maia: Thanks all 680
